rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a puzzle as a pastime or brain game, rather than a specific jigsaw.

example.english: When I was little, I loved playing puzzle games.
example.traditional: 我細個最鍾意玩益智遊戲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 waan2 jik1 zi3 jau4 hei3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a jigsaw puzzle or a similar physical picture puzzle.

example.english: This jigsaw puzzle has a thousand pieces, and I spent the whole afternoon on it without finishing it.
example.traditional: 呢盒砌圖有一千塊，我砌咗成個下午都未砌完。
example.jyutping: ni1 hap6 cai3 tou4 jau5 jat1 cin1 faai3 ngo5 cai3 zo2 sing4 go3 haa6 ng5 dou1 mei6 cai3 jyun4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for trying to work out or puzzling over a difficult matter.

example.english: I need to puzzle over this problem for a while.
example.traditional: 呢條數真係要諗一陣先。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 zan1 hai6 jiu3 nam2 jat1 zan6 sin1

rows.note: Use this when something causes someone to become confused or mystified, including when they confuse themselves.

example.english: That explanation really did puzzle me.
example.traditional: 你講到咁複雜，搞懵我喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dou3 gam3 fuk1 zaap6 gaau2 mung2 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a mystery or enigma, such as an unexplained event or person.

example.english: The case is still a puzzle even after the police have investigated it for so long.
example.traditional: 警方查咗咁耐，呢宗案仲係一個謎團。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 caa4 zo2 gam3 noi6 ni1 zung1 on3 zung6 hai6 jat1 go3 mai4 tyun4

rows.note: Use this when someone cannot understand or figure out a complicated matter.

example.english: I can't puzzle out this problem.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 ngo5 gaau2 m4 ming4

rows.note: Use this for the state of bewilderment or confusion caused by something hard to understand.

example.english: This result is a puzzle to me and leaves me confused.
example.traditional: 呢個結果令我感到困惑。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 ling6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 kwan3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on successfully working through and solving the problem.

example.english: I finally managed to puzzle through this difficult problem.
example.traditional: 我終於解決咗呢個難題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 ni1 go3 naan4 tai4
